message.text: Role execution complies with strict boundaries: D9-R1 (Sandbox Build) and D9-R2 (Real-World Stress Probe) executed strictly by assigned specialist eric; reviewer audit gate executed by reviewer with zero orchestrator inline bypass.
All required deliverables exist on disk and SHA-256 hashes cryptographically match output/SHA256SUMS.txt with 100 percent integrity.

Hero metric anonymous rate limit confirmed: strictly 10 requests allowed (HTTP 200) followed by 40 rejections (HTTP 429) on anonymous client, with authenticated tier quota confirmed at 100 requests per minute.

Hero metric rejection latency confirmed: server rejection latency averaged 0.127ms (P99 0.841ms) during R1 load test and 0.141ms (P50 0.106ms, P90 0.190ms) during R2 stress probe, strictly under the 1.0ms SLA target.
Hero metric RFC 6585 headers confirmed: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Retry-After-Seconds, and standard Retry-After headers verified on all HTTP 429 rejections.

Hero metric IP spoofing resistance confirmed: untrusted direct connections drop forged X-Forwarded-For headers; trusted reverse proxies correctly resolve genuine client IP via backward traversal, preventing header rotation evasion.

Hero metric high-concurrency race condition defense confirmed: 100 simultaneous requests against 10 tokens yielded exactly 10 allowed (HTTP 200), 90 rejected (HTTP 429), and 0 overflows, backed by atomic CAS token operations.

Hero metric degradation probe confirmed: simulated backend outage resulted in graceful fail-open with X-RateLimit-Degraded header emitted across 20/20 requests and 0 API crashes, with configurable fail-closed mode returning HTTP 503 RFC 7807 problem details.
Strict zero em dashes check passed: 0 em dashes detected across all Java source code, test suites, Python harnesses, markdown reports, and JSON manifests.
